tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The page behind everything.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs, dialogs: anything that sits on the ground.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Sunken or hovered areas inside a surface: table header, hovered row, secondary button.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Borders between things on a surface; table rules.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, checkboxes) and hovered lines.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on ground, surface and surface-2.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, table cells.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Muted text: hints, captions, labels of small stats. 4.5:1 on surface and ground.

tokens.name: ink-4
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled text only: below 4.5:1, never for text people must read.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The one main action per view, selected states, the brand's mark. A design changes this first.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: brand while hovered or pressed.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: A quiet brand tint: selected rows, the brand badge, the active link.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus rings: 2px, offset 2px from the control.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done, paid, live, up. Text and icons on surface or success-soft.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind success text: badges, alerts.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs attention soon: due, low, pending. Text on surface or warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind warning text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed, overdue, down, destructive actions. Text on surface or danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind danger text.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill (the danger button).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral news: new, scheduled, a tip. Text on surface or info-soft.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind info text.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: The scrim behind a dialog.

families.display: "Wix Madefor Display Variable", "Wix Madefor Display", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
families.body: "Wix Madefor Text Variable", "Wix Madefor Text", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: The largest text on an app screen: a welcome, an empty workspace.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.usage: Card titles, empty states, small section headings.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Pick a time and we'll confirm by email.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Invoices are sent on the first of the month.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, buttons, tabs, links in the sidebar.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding; gap in a form row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on small screens; gap between fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections of a screen.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty states; page top padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Sections on public pages.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, alerts, menus.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs and large panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, switches, pills.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Resting cards and inputs.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, menus, popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Dialogs.

fontWeight.note: Tuned to the face: a thin face (Manrope) takes heavier numbers, so every face reads at the same stroke as Wix Madefor.

tokens.name: font-weight-normal
tokens.usage: Body text.

tokens.name: font-weight-medium
tokens.usage: Labels, buttons, links, the first column of a table (font-medium).

tokens.name: font-weight-semibold
tokens.usage: Titles and headings (font-semibold).

tokens.name: font-weight-bold
tokens.usage: Rare: a number that must stand out (font-bold).

fontAdjust.note: The x-height every face is drawn at, as a share of its size: Wix Madefor's is 0.492. With another face, set it so that face reads the same size.

tokens.name: font-size-adjust
tokens.usage: none for Wix Madefor; ex-height 0.492 to size another face like it.
